*/
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :P_LIC_NBR IS NULL THEN
 :P_LIC_TYPE:=NULL;
 
END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_list IS
 
 v_rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 F VARCHAR2(7);
 T VARCHAR2(11);
 BEGIN
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('DCLN_STA');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('DCLN_STA',
 'SELECT DISTINCT min( DCLTN_STA_DESC),TO_CHAR(DCLTN_STA_CD) 
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE ((DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,3,4,5,7,15,17)AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) OR 
 (DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1) AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,2,3,4,10,11))
 group by DCLTN_STA_CD 
 UNION
 SELECT ''الكل'',
 ''0'' FROM DUAL
 ORDER BY 2
 ');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('P_DCLTN_STA',v_rg_id);
 
 
 END if;
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 END;
